summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed Form 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 741,238 Class I common shares for $17,712,545 in a private offering under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, a capital raise, not a special situation. The filing also declared routine monthly distributions and provided portfolio commentary (NAV $23.90, ~$25.1B portfolio, 99% first lien). No merger, tender, activist, restructuring or strategic review. This is a routine capital markets update for a BDC. No deal terms apply.
